citations.quote: Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: missiles or falling objects; fire; theft or larceny; explosion or earthquake; windstorm; hail, water or flood; malicious mischief or vandalism; riot or civil commotion; contact with a bird or animal; or breakage of glass.

output.reasoning: 1. Cause of loss: The claimant states an earthquake caused a carport roof to collapse onto the car. 2. Insuring clause: [COMP-1] covers 'falling objects' and 'earthquake' as other-than-collision losses. 3. Exclusions: [EXC-1] (wear and tear) does not apply as the damage is from a falling object. [EXC-2] (commercial use) is not mentioned. [EXC-3] (racing) is not mentioned. [EXC-4] (intentional damage) is not mentioned. [EXC-5] (unlicensed driver) is not mentioned. [EXC-6] (personal property) is not applicable to the vehicle's roof/windshield. [EXC-7] (nuclear/war) does not apply to earthquake. The claim establishes the cause as an earthquake/falling object, which is covered under the comprehensive clause.
